(async()=>{ const P=__app.player, V=__app.view; P.video.pause(); P.seekTo(0.5); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); return await window.vr180.saveSnapshot(V.snapshot(), 'lvl_off'); })()

(async()=>{ __app.showTab('calibrate'); document.querySelector('[data-tour=level]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,4000)); return JSON.stringify({ mode: __app.player.level()?.mode, fixed: __app.player.level()?.fixed, n: __app.player.level()?.rolls?.length, note: document.querySelector('[data-tour=level]').nextElementSibling.textContent }); })()
(async()=>{ const P=__app.player, V=__app.view; __app.showTab('player'); P.seekTo(0.5); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return await window.vr180.saveSnapshot(V.snapshot(), 'lvl_on'); })()

(async()=>{ await __app.player.setCalib({ lut: 'builtin:bw', pictureOn: true }); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const V=__app.view; V.render(); const gl=V.renderer.getContext(); const b=new Uint8Array(4); gl.readPixels(Math.floor(V.canvas.width*0.25), Math.floor(V.canvas.height/2), 1,1, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, b); const bw=[...b].slice(0,3); await __app.player.setCalib({ lut: null }); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); V.render(); gl.readPixels(Math.floor(V.canvas.width*0.25), Math.floor(V.canvas.height/2), 1,1, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, b); return 'with B&W look: ' + bw.join(',') + ' | without: ' + [...b].slice(0,3).join(','); })()

(async()=>{ __app.player.openExport(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); document.querySelectorAll('.modal .target-seg button')[1].click(); return document.querySelector('.modal-body').innerText.replace(/\n+/g,' | ').slice(0,600); })()

(async()=>{ document.querySelector('.modal .card-head .ibtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); document.querySelector('[data-tour=edit]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); document.querySelector('.edit-clip .btn').click(); return document.querySelector('.edit-list').innerText.replace(/\n+/g,' | '); })()
